The Qixi Festival marriage registration peak is approaching. Alipay's government AI assistant "Xiaozheng," in collaboration with the Ministry of Civil Affairs' Minzheng Tong platform, has launched a special marriage registration convenience service. excerpt_i18n.en: On August 19, analysts at Wall Street investment bank Jefferies recently conducted real-world office task tests on eight mainstream global AI Agents. Results showed that through the synergy of models and Harness, Alibaba's Qwen Office ranked first in overall office scores, surpassing US Agent tools such as Claude Cowork and Codex. The test covered five real office tasks, including compiling company annual report summaries from multiple documents, searching and comparing company operating data online, operating a real desktop browser for information retrieval and document generation, creating English PPTs from data, and generating marketing posters based on reference images. Test results showed that Qwen Office performed consistently well overall, particularly outstanding in complex office tasks, web browser control, and multimodal content generation, and was the only Agent product to score above 90 across all evaluation dimensions. The report further analyzed Agent capabilities by breaking them down into model and Harness components. The so-called Harness is a complete set of engineering mechanisms running around the model, including instructions, context, tool calling, boundary control, feedback correction, and governance. According to Jefferies' estimates, Qwen Office's "implied Harness score" ranked first among the tested products, higher than seven mainstream domestic and international Agent products including Claude Cowork and Codex.
